description: This file declares the 'Response' class within the 'WebSockets::JsonRpc' namespace, which inherits from a base message class and provides methods related to JSON-RPC response handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response details such as ID, result, error, and validity.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default virtual destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with this response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if present.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the response is valid.
